title: C-4 — worker_{node_id}_{run_id}.jsonl (Divyansh, A)
description:
All durations are worker-local engine clocks.

F-9: every pool node runs llama.cpp, whose server returns a `timings` block with prompt_ms and predicted_ms — so the F-18 prefill/decode split comes from ONE code path for the whole pool rather than two engine-specific ones. If the pinned llama.cpp build does not expose it, log service_ns only and record f18_status='partial' in the manifest rather than faking the split.

`engine` is retained because the F-9b engine-gap probe emits worker records too.

engine.description: 'llamacpp' for pool nodes; 'vllm' only for the F-9b probe.

prefill_ns.description: Omit if the pinned engine version does not expose it (F-18 partial).

decode_ns.description: Omit if the pinned engine version does not expose it (F-18 partial).

batch_size_at_admission.description: F-4: routing considers the COMPOSITION of a target's in-flight set, not only its depth.

kv_occupancy_at_admission.description: llama.cpp exposes slot occupancy rather than paged-KV occupancy; report the fraction of --parallel slots in use. Omit or -1.0 where unavailable.
